# CurlToCode

> CurlToCode is a private, browser-based HTTP request converter for cURL and source code. Conversion is static and entirely client-side: the site never executes, uploads, or sends the requests users paste.

## Main pages

- [Converter](https://curltocode.com/): Convert cURL to supported languages and libraries, or statically parse supported source code back to cURL.
- [All converters](https://curltocode.com/converters): Browse every supported forward generator and reverse parser.
- [About CurlToCode](https://curltocode.com/about): Product architecture, privacy model, and project scope.

## Primary cURL generators

- [cURL to Python](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-python): Requests, HTTPX, and aiohttp.
- [cURL to JavaScript](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-javascript): Fetch, Axios, and Undici.
- [cURL to TypeScript](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-typescript): Typed Fetch, Axios, and Undici output.
- [cURL to Go](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-go): net/http and Resty.
- [cURL to Rust](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-rust): reqwest and ureq.
- [cURL to Java](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-java): JDK HttpClient, OkHttp, and Apache HttpClient.

## Reverse parsers

- [JavaScript to cURL](https://curltocode.com/javascript-to-curl): Static Fetch and Axios parsing without code execution.
- [TypeScript to cURL](https://curltocode.com/typescript-to-curl): Static Fetch and Axios parsing without code execution.
- [Python to cURL](https://curltocode.com/python-to-curl): Static Requests, HTTPX, and aiohttp parsing without code execution.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://curltocode.com/privacy): How hosting and advertising data are handled; converter content is excluded.
- [Terms of Service](https://curltocode.com/terms): Usage terms and generated-code limitations.
